import graphene
from graphql import GraphQLError
from .models import OrganizationApiKey

class ApiKeyType(graphene.ObjectType):
    key_id = graphene.String()
    secret_preview = graphene.String()

class Query(graphene.ObjectType):
    active_api_keys = graphene.List(ApiKeyType, org_slug=graphene.String())

    def resolve_active_api_keys(self, info, org_slug=None):
        user = info.context.user
        if not user.is_authenticated:
            raise GraphQLError('Authentication required')

        target_slug = org_slug if org_slug else user.organization.slug
        # Verify that authenticated user belongs to the targeted organization
        if user.organization.slug != target_slug:
            raise GraphQLError('Access denied to specified organization')

        keys = OrganizationApiKey.objects.filter(organization__slug=target_slug)
        return [ApiKeyType(key_id=k.key_id, secret_preview=k.secret[:8] + '...') for k in keys]
